method: Timestamped AudioWorklet captures the actual post-master digital output. Spectral flux in 40–180 / 180–1200 / 4000–10000 Hz compares each original-stem window with its browser capture. Both raw +/-30 ms matches and one shared +/-120 ms latency fit per capture are reported; no time warping. Before uses the previous frame fallback; after uses the recovered score and corrected content clock.

transcription.limits: Detector agreement is not transcription accuracy; cymbal/tom labels remain uncertain.

limitations: Not a human transcription or a realism score.
Recorded drums contain separation leakage; high-band flux includes snare and cymbals.
Capture starts differ slightly. Windows are not sample-aligned or loudness matched.
The source recordings, bass and guitar scores and bank were preserved.
Actual iPhone playback and subjective quality remain unverified.
